subject: Stellara security intake & kickoff - scheduling and action owners
messages:
From: Lara Monroe <lara@stellarahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-07T09:12:00Z
Subject: Stellara security intake & kickoff

Hi Ben & Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing a SOC 2 + SIG (CAIQ) intake and would like to set up a 60-minute kickoff to review scope, data flows, evidence owners, and sequencing. Our preferred week is June 9–13. Can you share a couple of 30/60 minute windows and a brief agenda?

Also: attached is a short list of high-level items the audit team will want up front. For the kickoff, our primary objectives are:
- Confirm in-scope services and regions (we have US + EU instances)
- Confirm evidence collection owners and access for logs/samples
- Align on expected timeline for SOC 2 readiness artifacts and SIG responses

Attendees from our side likely: myself (security), Aaron Field (DevOps lead), and one of our product owners.

Thanks — would like to lock something in by EOD Friday.

Best,
Lara Monroe
Head of Security
Stellara Health
Attachment: Stellara_Security_Topics.pdf (PDF)

Hi Lara — thanks for the note. June 10 or June 12 both work for our team; suggested slots (all PT):
- Tue, Jun 10 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, Jun 12 — 13:00–14:00 PT

Quick agenda (proposed):
1) Introductions & scope confirmation (10m)
2) Evidence owners & sample artifacts (20m)
3) SIG/CAIQ question triage & timeline (20m)
4) Next steps & action owners (10m)

I've attached a short pre-call checklist and our evidence-matrix template to speed handoffs. Rishi will join the kickoff to triage any infra/logging questions and to confirm log export options. Marissa will drive the post-call action register and HubSpot updates.

If either slot works for you, I can send a calendar invite and include a quick pre-read.

Thanks Lara — Ben's proposed slots look good. For clarity, adding a slightly expanded agenda and pre-call asks so we can make the 60 minutes productive:

Pre-call asks (please share if available before the meeting):
- Primary list of in-scope services & region(s) (prod/dev/staging)
- Lead contact for each artifact (name + email) — e.g., Aaron Field for logs
- Any existing compliance reports (previous SOC, ISO summaries)

Kickoff agenda (60m):
- 0–10m: Introductions & scope confirmation (Ben)
- 10–30m: Evidence matrix walkthrough & ownership (Marissa)
- 30–50m: SIG question triage — which we can handle live vs. takeaways (Rishi)
- 50–60m: Timeline and next steps; confirm access + delivery windows (Ben/Marissa)

Attachments: redwood-evidence-matrix-template.xlsx, redwood-soc2-quickref.pdf

Marissa (I'll build the action register in HubSpot as we go).

- Lara Monroe (security)
- Aaron Field (DevOps) <aaron.field@stellarahealth.com>
- Priya Shah (product) <priya.shah@stellarahealth.com>
